description: Bus stops and schedules is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for Greater Manchester. Bus and Metrolink stop and time data for all services within the Greater Manchester boundary. Known technically as "ATCO-CIF". Coverage: Transport for Greater Manchester. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Greater Manchester. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2022-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
